desc: Copy the world model with selected causal laws or axioms changed, search inside each altered world, then map the results back and keep only what passes real-world verification
Propose new primitives or representations, accept those that shorten descriptions (MDL) across the knowledge base, then refactor the library or frame so the next search starts from the new one
Find disagreements or inconsistencies in the system's own predictions and invent new latent variables or structural edits that resolve as many as possible at the lowest complexity cost
Reward outputs that a continually updated density model or predictor finds improbable, but that verifiers judge valid, so that past novelty stops earning reward
Evolutionary or quality-diversity program search (LLM as mutation operator, automated evaluators, MAP-Elites style archives) that grows open-ended populations of solutions
Self-play reinforcement learning against verifiable rewards (games, theorem provers, code execution) so that capability and strategies go beyond the human data, as in AlphaZero or AlphaProof
Active, embodied or closed-loop experimentation (robot labs, simulators, real-world probes) that gathers new data the training corpus never contained
Explicit structure mapping between distant domains (bisociation, conceptual blending over relational graphs) to transfer deep structure rather than surface features
Inject controlled noise, chaos or attractor dynamics into latent activations, followed by selection, to escape high-probability modes (stochastic resonance, annealing)
An adversarial society of agents (generator vs. critic, debate, a market of ideas) whose competing perspectives and critique push past consensus outputs
Multi-agent populations co-evolve their own symbolic languages without human priors, keep abstractions that compress solutions, and translate them for humans only afterwards
